in_sanskrit.name: निरवती
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is free from the turbulence of worldly life, calm, peaceful.

in_marathi.name: Niravati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Stream of Purity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niravati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'nira' meaning 'stream' and 'vati' meaning 'purity'.

in_bengali.name: Niravati
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Stream of Purity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Niravati একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'nira' meaning 'stream' and 'vati' meaning 'purity'.
